name: zenith-demo
description: Zenith health insurance issuance demo: journey frontend + core policy system + AI feasibility portal

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix core-service install && npm --prefix ai-service install && npm --prefix edw-service install && npm --prefix journey-app install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,ai,edw,web -c green,magenta,yellow,cyan "cross-env PORT=4001 npm --prefix core-service start" "cross-env PORT=4002 npm --prefix ai-service start" "cross-env PORT=4003 npm --prefix edw-service start" "npm --prefix journey-app run dev"
